name: The Late-Night FM DJ Cadence
scenario: Managing an escalation meeting where the counterparty's leadership is shouting, banging the conference table, and issuing threats.
script: (Lower vocal register by one full octave, reduce delivery cadence by 30%, apply strict downward terminal inflection) "We cannot solve this mission-critical deployment failure while voices are elevated. We will walk through the server incident timeline step by step, right now."
defense: Name the cost of the cadence: downtime runs at $50,000 per hour; we need urgent action, not vocal pacing.
originFull: Polyvagal Theory and Acoustic Neuro-Regulation establish that low-frequency, downward-inflecting, and deliberate vocal acoustics trigger parasympathetic regulation, reducing social threat appraisal and suppressing conversational arousal.
defenseFull: When an opponent uses an artificially soothing cadence to control tempo: "I appreciate your calm tone, but the operational downtime continues to cost our firm $50,000 per hour. We need urgent action, not vocal pacing."
